items.statement: After adjustment for case mix and pre-adoption trends, 30-day readmission falls by at least 3 percentage points more at adopting centres than at comparison centres after March 2025.
items.rationale: The trial and review suggest a benefit of this order; the network data can test it with before-and-after contrasts.
items.risks: Two adopting centres; contamination at centre C.

items.statement: Remote monitoring costs less than 20,000 per readmission avoided.
items.rationale: At about 1,400 per patient, this threshold is reached if the readmission effect in h1 holds.
items.risks: Imprecise effect makes the ratio unstable.

items.statement: The effect is smaller for patients aged over 80 and in rural areas.
items.rationale: Carer dependence and connectivity losses reported in interviews.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 supplies the effect the economic analysis needs.
